race.comment: Open race and happy to stick with the speedy TSUYOI KITSUNE (10). Led fresh and was in front until the death when grabbed late and finished runner-up behind Gold Armour. Fitter and senior rider stays aboard. Tricky gate but will take catching again. LIN THIZZY (6) had one run in first campaign when beaten for speed and made late ground finishing seventh over 1000m. Has upside and expecting a strong run fresh. ROLAND VIEW (8) is going better than recent form suggest and is one of the chances. MIDWAY POINT (3) is mixing form but senior rider goes on from the inside gate and can improve sharply. STEEL SPANIEL (13) is a three-year-old filly making debut by Rebel Dane out of Ironic Smile. Placed in two trials and blinkers on for debut. Expected to run well.
